questions.stem: A 25-year-old patient presents with fever and weight loss. He gives a history of blood in the stools and vomiting 2 weeks ago. On examination, there is right hypochondriac tenderness and hepatomegaly. Abdominal CT a lesion in the right lobe of the liver with ragged edges, multiple septations, and heterogenous densities. What is the most likely diagnosis?
